lines.text: This is it. Kelabu is attacking the Finance team today.

lines.speaker: rani
lines.text: The attack comes in steps: fake emails, hacked accounts, then harmful files spreading. Follow the trail from one case to the next.

lines.speaker: rani
lines.text: The last chapter is open: Incident Response. Contain the spread first, then clean up. If the impact is big, escalate.

lines.speaker: rani
lines.text: You made it through the toughest day. This is what being a real SOC analyst feels like.

lines.text: If you want, try the Final Test in the office menu to see how far you've come.
